units.source_text: 有一天薰大将和二公主谈话，

en.t: One day, General Kaoru was talking with the Second Princess,

units.source_text: 便中他对二公主说：“有一件事，说出来生怕对你不起，

en.t: and in the course of their conversation he said to her, "There is something that I have been afraid to tell you, because I feared it would wrong you,
and so I have not dared to speak of it until now.

units.source_text: 不瞒你说：我早年就有一个女子养在外面。

en.t: To tell you the truth, since my younger days I have had a woman under my care elsewhere.

units.source_text: 这女子一向被舍弃在荒僻地方，十分孤苦伶仃，

en.t: She has long been left in a remote and desolate place, terribly lonely and helpless,

units.source_text: 我看她可怜，想叫她到附近地方来居住。

en.t: and because I pity her, I want to bring her to live somewhere nearby.

units.source_text: 我的性情自昔就和常人不同，

en.t: My nature has always been different from that of ordinary people,

units.source_text: 不爱寻常家庭生活，常怀遗世独立之想。

en.t: and I have never cared for ordinary family life, but have often wished to withdraw from the world and live apart.

units.source_text: 然而自从与公主结缡之后，

en.t: Yet ever since I married you, Princess,

units.source_text: 就未便任意抛舍这尘世了。

en.t: it has no longer been proper for me to cast off this world as I pleased.

units.source_text: 连这个一向不使人知的女子也叫我关怀，

en.t: Even this woman, whom I have always kept hidden from others, weighs on my mind,
and I feel as though abandoning her would be a sin."

units.source_text: 二公主答道：“我不知道什么事情可以使我嫉妒。”

en.t: The Second Princess replied, "I do not know what there is in this that should make me jealous."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“恐怕有人在皇上面前说我的坏话吧。

en.t: General Kaoru said, "I fear someone may speak ill of me before His Majesty.

units.source_text: 世人搬是弄非，实在荒谬可恶！

en.t: People are always stirring up right and wrong; it is truly absurd and hateful!

units.source_text: 为了这女子，不值得大惊小怪。”

en.t: This woman is not worth making such a great fuss over."
